records.title: Own Source Revenue of Gram Panchayats.
details: Part (d) & (e); The Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR) has also constituted a committee to formulate Model Rules for the Own Sources of Revenue of the Panchayats, which would serve as a benchmark for states in formulating or revising their OSR rules.

records.title: Maintenance of NH 38
details: Part (a) to (c)Yes sir. The project was initially awarded to M/s. Madurai-Tuticorin Expressways Ltd. under BOT (Toll). However, due to various defaults of Concessionaire, the contract was terminated on 17.03.2023. After the termination of the contract, the work for overlaying and maintenance of the entire stretch was awarded for Rs. 144.6 crore. So far, overlaying has been completed in a length of 46.3 km, and the remaining work is scheduled to be completed by December 2025.
